newsitem.title: UK: INCO on target for 1997 production, demand.
newsitem.headline: INCO on target for 1997 production, demand.

text.p: Canada's Inco Ltd is on target to meet is production target this year, with the demand outlook suggesting a deficit, Inco President Scott M. Hand said.
"Our plan is to produce 430 million lbs of nickel. As we sit here today we are going to produce that amount. Production is going well, we have not had any problems," Hand said in an interview.
"In terms of demand we are optimistic for 1997...Demand should exceed supply by something like 15,000 tonnes," he said.
Looking ahead into 1998, and assuming that the economies continue to perform reasonably well, next year is likely to be even better in terms of supply and demand.
"So as you look over the next couple of years we see the nickel market being favourable," Hand added.
